name: SuperGLUE
description: A benchmark suite of eight challenging language understanding tasks designed to evaluate general-purpose language models, including coreference resolution, question answering, textual entailment, and word sense disambiguation.
citation: Wang, A., Pruksachatkun, Y., Nangia, N., et al. (2019). SuperGLUE: A Stickier Benchmark for General-Purpose Language Understanding Systems. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32. https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.00537

license.notes: The benchmark materials do not specify a single standard SPDX license for SuperGLUE; component datasets may have distinct terms. Access to the official evaluation/test labels is restricted through the benchmark submission process. Review component dataset terms before use or redistribution.
